meta.name: burn-rate-management
meta.description: Don't die. Runway calculation, default alive vs. default dead, when to raise vs. cut, zero-based budgeting for startups. The math that keeps companies alive long enough to win.  Burn rate is not just accounting - it's strategic leverage. Companies with runway have options. Companies without runway have desperation. Use when "burn rate, runway, default alive, default dead, how much money, when to raise, cutting costs, layoffs, cash management, should we hire, running out of money, bridge round, extend runway, ramen profitable, finance, runway, cash, burn, survival, fundraising, startup" mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算创业公司现金流跑道，决定融资或削减开支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是创业公司创始人或CFO，需要管理现金流和融资时机。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate startup cash runway, decide when to raise or cut costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a startup founder or CFO needing to manage cash flow and fundraising timing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演一位经验丰富的 CFO，分析你的现金消耗率和跑道，判断公司是“默认存活”还是“默认死亡”，并给出何时融资、削减成本或零基预算的建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 burn rate、runway、default alive、default dead 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的公司每月烧钱80万，账上还有500万，还能撑多久？
say.note: Claude 会计算 runway 并评估是否安全。

say.text: 我们该不该裁员来延长跑道？
say.note: Claude 会分析利弊并给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an experienced CFO, analyzing your burn rate and runway, determining if you are default alive or default dead, and advising on when to raise funds, cut costs, or apply zero-based budgeting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as burn rate, runway, default alive, default dead, etc.

say_en.text: My company burns $80k per month with $5M in the bank. How long can we survive?
say_en.note: Claude will calculate runway and assess safety.

say_en.text: Should we lay off people to extend our runway?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze trade-offs and suggest actions.
